verdict.rationale: The official ScrapingBee CLI provides a `crawl` command that scrapes many pages in one operation (same-domain or sitemap crawls), plus exports, which is a first-party form of multi-item processing. The core HTML API is documented per URL, though, and nothing shows a batch endpoint or a bulk job that takes an arbitrary list of items. Scheduling is a recurring trigger, not a bulk operation, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk endpoint for submitting many URLs or items at once, details on how bulk CLI runs handle input lists, concurrency, results and errors, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Quick same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl, or Scrapy-project spider.
Use the official ScrapingBee command-line interface for scraping, crawling, exports, schedules, and dedicated APIs.
